name: GF(2) Subspace Span Disguise
description: The problem is recast from finding a subgroup orbit generated by transpositions to finding a minimum-cost subset of vectors of the form $b_u + b_v$ that span $b_x + b_y$ for all priority coordinate pairs $x, y$ over GF(2). This is mathematically isomorphic to the Steiner tree problem on graphs, but models will likely fail to map the linear algebra concepts (spanning over a finite field) to the graph connectivity algorithm (Dreyfus-Wagner/Subset DP) required to solve it optimally.
